flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ff0000 then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Open the color picker from the red swatch next to the search field.
Press Tab through at least three controls unless the swatch gets focus sooner.
If it gets focus, @v16:"press Enter".
Verify the color spectrum and hue slider appear.

verdict.root_cause: After the red swatch received keyboard focus, the required Enter key action was not recorded. The displayed page remained on the normal color-information view, so the final check looked for picker controls that had not been opened.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent correctly used Tab to reach the swatch, as recorded at step 0-5, but it did not complete the explicit required action, press Enter, once focus was obtained. Step 0-6 has no recorded action, and the supplied images do not show an open picker. The later claim that the hue slider appeared was therefore a misread rather than evidence that both required picker controls were visible.
verdict.bug_title: Color picker was not opened after swatch focus
